name: sglang_pr43753_full
description: Gemma 4 vision pooler, the full sglang PR #43753 against sglang 0.5.23: mask_pad_before_pool on, pooling in float32, the scaled pooler output kept in float32 until the encoder's standardization. Applies to Gemma 4 models with a vision tower (Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration, e.g. 31B); gemma-4-12B-it (gemma4_unified) has none.
